models_evaluated: GPT-3.5 with DocsBot retrieval from two clinical guidelines (Bot2)

links.outcome: Concordance of chatbot recommendations with clinical guidelines on pharmacological versus non-pharmacological interventions
links.effect: Both bots favored counselling over pharmacological options despite guidelines recommending both; OR=47.3 in Bot1 (95% CI 9.55 to 233.81) and 97.2 in Bot2 (95% CI 11.72 to 806.04), p<0.001.
links.quote: For sexual response and sexual function, the guidelines recommended both pharmacological and non-pharmacological intervention for them, non-pharmacological intervention (counselling) was significantly more frequently than pharmacological intervention (OR=47.3 in Bot1 (95% CI 9.55 to 233.81, p<0.001), 97.2 in Bot2 (95% CI 11.72 to 806.04, p<0.001)).

models_evaluated: DocsBot/GPT-3.5 sourced from two clinical guidelines (Bot2)

links.outcome: censorship of sexual and medical terms
links.effect: No censorship of sexual expressions or medical terms occurred.
links.quote: No censorship of sexual expressions or medical terms occurred.

links.outcome: guideline grounding effect on intervention recommendations
links.effect: Guideline-sourced Bot2 still favored consultation over pharmacological interventions, OR 97.2 (p<0.001); Bot1 OR 47.3 (p<0.001).
links.quote: Despite the lack of reflection on guideline recommendations, 'consultation' was significantly more prevalent in both bots' responses compared with pharmacological interventions, with ORs of 47.3 (p<0.001) in Bot1 and 97.2 (p<0.001) in Bot2.

links.effect: Non-pharmacological intervention was more frequent than pharmacological: OR=47.3 in Bot1 and 97.2 in Bot2, both p<0.001.
links.quote: For sexual response and sexual function, the guidelines recommended both pharmacological and non-pharmacological intervention for them, non-pharmacological intervention (counselling) was significantly more frequently than pharmacological intervention (OR=47.3 in Bot1 (95% CI 9.55 to 233.81, p<0.001), 97.2 in Bot2 (95% CI 11.72 to 806.04, p<0.001)).

links.outcome: concordance with guideline recommendations and non-pharmacological versus pharmacological intervention frequency
links.effect: Bot1 and Bot2 responses were highly similar (mean similarity 0.93); non-pharmacological counselling was favored over pharmacological interventions in both Bot1 (OR=47.3, p<0.001) and Bot2 (OR=97.2, p<0.001).
